name: mcp-pdf
description: Merge, split, extract, rotate, reorder and stamp PDF files from chat: mark an invoice PAID, pull pages out of a scan, join a set of documents into one. Everything stays on your machine.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Call this tool to inspect a PDF: page count, page sizes in points/mm, paper name, metadata (title, author, producer, dates) and whether it is encrypted. Read-only, never modifies the file. Free tier: unlimited.

tools.name: pdf_count
tools.description: Page count per file plus the total, for any number of PDFs. Read-only. A file that cannot be read is reported per file; the others still count. Free tier: unlimited.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Call this tool to join several PDFs into one, in the order given. Page sizes are kept as-is, so a merged file may have mixed sizes, and the answer says so. Inputs are never modified. Free tier: up to 5 files per merge.

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Call this tool to write one new PDF per range. Ranges are 1-based and may be open-ended: "1-3,5,7-" gives pages 1-3, page 5, and 7 to the end. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

tools.name: pdf_pages
tools.description: Call this tool to pull selected pages into one new PDF, in the order written: "2,4-6" gives four pages. Asking for a page twice copies it twice. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Call this tool to turn pages by a multiple of 90 degrees, clockwise for positive. Rotation is added to whatever the page already had, for a sideways scan. Writes a new file. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

tools.name: pdf_stamp
tools.description: Call this tool to draw a word such as PAID or DRAFT across the pages, in a colour and position you choose. Writes a new file; input untouched. Free tier: the PAID and DRAFT presets in their preset colours.

tools.name: pdf_watermark_business
tools.description: Call this tool to put your business name and VAT id in the footer of every page, from the shared profile mcp-invoice and mcp-docx write. Use it before sending a document out. Pro.

tools.name: pdf_reorder
tools.description: Call this tool to write a new PDF with pages in the order you give. The order must name every page exactly once, so nothing drops by accident; use pdf_pages for a subset. Pro.

tools.name: pdf_text
tools.description: Call this tool for best-effort text extraction from standard-font PDFs. Returns nothing for a scan (no OCR), or glyph indices for a custom-encoded font, and says which case applies. Read-only. Free tier: unlimited.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
